data.label: Instagram vs Website
data.title:
Why Instagram alone is
*hurting your business*
data.sub: Swipe to see what you're missing →

data.label: Tip #1
data.title: You don't *own the platform*
data.body: If Instagram changes its algorithm or suspends your account, your entire business presence vanishes overnight. Own your digital home instead.
data.fix: Fix: Launch a simple website that you fully control.

data.label: Tip #2
data.title: You’re invisible to *Google search*
data.body: People searching for local services like yours use Google, not Instagram. A website helps customers find you when they have an urgent need.
data.fix: Fix: Create a website optimized for local search terms.

data.label: Tip #3
data.title: It's hard to *build trust*
data.body: Social media feels like a casual feed, but a professional website shows you are a legitimate, established business ready to help.
data.fix: Fix: Add a professional gallery and service list online.

data.label: Tip #4
data.title: The *buying process* is difficult
data.body: Customers often struggle to find pricing or booking links on social profiles. A website provides a clear path for them to hire you.
data.fix: Fix: Put a 'Book Now' button on your homepage.

data.label: Tip #5
data.title: Distractions *kill your sales*
data.body: On Instagram, your customers are one click away from a competitor or a funny video. Your website keeps their focus on your services.
data.fix: Fix: Remove social links that lead away from booking.
